title: NEA Consumer Tariff Rates - Domestic Single Phase
text:
NEA Domestic Consumer Electricity Tariff Rates (Current, ERC Approved)

Meter: 5 Ampere (5A) — Single Phase
- 0 to 20 units: Energy charge FREE (Rs. 0 per unit). Pay only Rs. 30 service charge. Subsidy for low-income households — approx 2.2 million customers benefit.
- 21 to 30 units: Rs. 6.50 per unit. Service charge Rs. 50.
- 31 to 50 units: Rs. 8.00 per unit. Service charge Rs. 50.
- 51 to 150 units: Rs. 9.50 per unit. Service charge Rs. 75.
- 151 to 250 units: Rs. 9.50 per unit. Service charge Rs. 100.
- Above 251 units: Rs. 11.00 per unit. Service charge Rs. 150.

Meter: 15 Ampere (15A) — Single Phase
- 0 to 20 units: Rs. 4.00 per unit. Service charge Rs. 50.
- 21 to 30 units: Rs. 6.50 per unit. Service charge Rs. 75.
- 31 to 50 units: Rs. 8.00 per unit. Service charge Rs. 75.
- 51 to 150 units: Rs. 9.50 per unit. Service charge Rs. 100.
- 151 to 250 units: Rs. 9.50 per unit. Service charge Rs. 125.
- Above 251 units: Rs. 11.00 per unit. Service charge Rs. 175.

Meter: 30 Ampere (30A) — Single Phase
- 0 to 20 units: Rs. 5.00 per unit. Service charge Rs. 75.
- 21 to 30 units: Rs. 6.50 per unit. Service charge Rs. 100.
- 31 to 50 units: Rs. 8.00 per unit. Service charge Rs. 100.
- 51 to 150 units: Rs. 9.50 per unit. Service charge Rs. 125.
- 151 to 250 units: Rs. 9.50 per unit. Service charge Rs. 150.
- Above 251 units: Rs. 11.00 per unit. Service charge Rs. 200.

Meter: 60 Ampere (60A) — Single Phase
- 0 to 20 units: Rs. 6.00 per unit. Service charge Rs. 125.
- 21 to 30 units: Rs. 6.50 per unit. Service charge Rs. 125.
- 31 to 50 units: Rs. 8.00 per unit. Service charge Rs. 125.
- 51 to 150 units: Rs. 9.50 per unit. Service charge Rs. 150.
- 151 to 250 units: Rs. 9.50 per unit. Service charge Rs. 200.
- Above 251 units: Rs. 11.00 per unit. Service charge Rs. 250.

NOTE: 13% VAT applies on top of all charges. Minimum bill for 5A meter is approximately Rs. 94 including VAT.

title: NEA Consumer Tariff Rates - Three Phase, Commercial, Industrial, Irrigation
text:
NEA Three Phase, Commercial, Industrial and Agricultural Tariff Rates

DOMESTIC THREE PHASE (Low Voltage 230/400V):
Up to 10 KVA: Service charge Rs. 1,100/month. Wet season (Ashad-Kartik) Rs. 10.50/unit. Dry season (Marga-Jestha) Rs. 11.50/unit.
Above 10 KVA: Service charge Rs. 1,800/month. Same seasonal rates apply.

COMMERCIAL (Low Voltage):
Service charge Rs. 200 minimum. Up to 500 units: Rs. 11.00/unit. Above 500 units: Rs. 13.00/unit.

INDUSTRIAL (Low Voltage 400/220V):
5A meter: Rs. 9.00/unit. 15A meter: Rs. 9.50/unit. 30A meter: Rs. 10.00/unit.

INDUSTRIAL (Medium Voltage 33/11 kV, above 25 KVA):
Minimum 2,500 units service charge Rs. 31,250. Above 2,500 units: Rs. 12.90/unit.

IRRIGATION / AGRICULTURAL:
Wet season: Rs. 2.25/unit. Dry season: Rs. 2.75/unit. Tariff reduced 40.69% to support farmers.

NET METERING (Rooftop Solar):
Install solar panels, consume own electricity, export surplus to grid. Receive credit on monthly bill. Apply at nearest NEA office.

title: NEA Key Facts - Generation Capacity, Statistics, History
text:
Nepal Electricity Authority (NEA) — Key Facts and Statistics

Established: August 16, 1985 (Bhadra 1, 2042 BS) under the Nepal Electricity Authority Act, 1984.
Formed by merger of: Department of Electricity (Ministry of Water Resources), Nepal Electricity Corporation, and related development boards.

Current Statistics (2024-2026):
- Total installed generation capacity: 4,296 MW (including IPPs)
- NEA-owned hydropower plants: 25+ plants, over 1,000 MW combined
- Transmission lines: 6,507 km total (132kV, 220kV, 400kV, 66kV)
- Distribution network: 150,000+ km of low and medium voltage lines
- Total registered consumers: 5.5 million+
- National electrification rate: 97%
- Exporting electricity to India (surplus in wet season)
- Started exporting to Bangladesh in 2024 via Indian transmission line (40 MW initial)

Major NEA Power Plants:
- Upper Tamakoshi: 456 MW
- Kali Gandaki A: 144 MW
- Kulekhani I and II: combined ~117 MW
- Middle Marsyangdi: 70 MW
- Marsyangdi: 69 MW
- Trishuli: 24 MW
- Chilime: 22 MW
- Modi Khola: 14.8 MW

NEA Goal: 24-hour reliable electricity to all Nepalis. Full electrification by 2026 per SDG/LDC commitments.

title: NEA Complaint Filing and Consumer Grievance
text:
How to File a Complaint with NEA

Online Complaint Portal: https://crm.nea.org.np/complain
  - File complaints about no-light, billing errors, meter issues, new connection delays, etc.
  - Available 24 hours, 7 days a week
  - You will receive a complaint ticket number for tracking

Phone Complaints:
  - Toll Free: 1400 (24 hours, 7 days)
  - Emergency No Light: 1402

For billing disputes:
  - Contact your nearest NEA sub-divisional office
  - Bring your electricity bill and SC number (Consumer ID)
  - NEA is required to investigate within 30 days

For meter reading errors:
  - You can check your own meter and compare with the bill
  - File complaint at local NEA office if readings don't match
  - NEA technician will visit for re-reading

title: NEA Bill Check and Online Payment
text:
How to Check NEA Electricity Bill Online

1. Go to https://www.neabilling.com/viewonline/
2. Enter your SC Number (Consumer ID) — printed on your electricity bill
3. View current bill, previous bills, and payment history

Online Payment Methods:
  - eSewa: Utilities > Nepal Electricity Authority > Enter SC Number
  - Khalti: Pay > Utilities > NEA
  - IME Pay: Utilities > NEA
  - FonePay: Available through most Nepal banks
  - Hamro Pay, Prabhu Pay also supported
  - ConnectIPS: https://connectips.com
  - Internet banking of most Nepal banks

Bank Counter Payment:
  - Nepal Bank Limited (NBL)
  - Rastriya Banijya Bank (RBB)
  - Agriculture Development Bank (ADBL)
  - Most commercial banks have NEA payment counters

NEA Office Payment:
  - Any NEA sub-divisional office or authorized collection center

Your SC Number / Consumer ID is the number on top of your monthly electricity bill. You need it for all online payments and inquiries.

title: NEA Careers and Recruitment Information
text:
Nepal Electricity Authority (NEA) — Career and Recruitment

Online Application Portal: https://career.nea.org.np/
Internal Employee Portal: https://hris.nea.org.np/

Types of Positions NEA Recruits For:
  - Engineers (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical)
  - Officers (Administration, Finance, IT, HR, Legal)
  - Assistant Officers
  - Sub-Engineers and Overseers
  - Technicians and Skilled Workers
  - Account Officers
  - IT Officers

Recruitment Process:
  - Open (external) recruitment: announced via nea.org.np homepage and national newspapers
  - Internal promotional recruitment: for existing NEA employees
  - Written examination followed by interview for most positions
  - All applications submitted online via career.nea.org.np

Eligibility Requirements:
  - Nepali citizenship required for all positions
  - Educational qualifications as specified in each vacancy notice
  - Age limit as per NEA regulations

For current vacancies: Visit https://nea.org.np → Careers section or https://career.nea.org.np
Vacancies also published in Gorkhapatra and Kantipur newspapers.

title: NEA Smart Meter (Prepaid Meter) Program
text:
NEA Smart Meter / Prepaid Meter Program

Smart Meter Portal: https://smartmeter.nea.org.np

What is a Smart Meter?
  Advanced digital electricity meters replacing old analog meters. Works like prepaid mobile recharge.

Benefits:
  - Prepaid: Recharge anytime, use what you need
  - No monthly billing cycle or bill shock
  - Real-time usage monitoring
  - Remote disconnection/reconnection by NEA (no technician needed)
  - Eliminates estimated billing
  - Reduces electricity theft

How to Recharge:
  - eSewa, Khalti, IME Pay and digital wallets
  - ConnectIPS and internet banking
  - NEA offices and authorized retailers

NEA is progressively rolling out smart meters across Nepal. Kathmandu Valley Smart Metering Project (Head End System - HES) already operational. Contact your nearest NEA office to inquire about installation.
